summary.en: AI operating system for real estate: a multi-agent B2B SaaS platform that runs property operations, CRM and marketing in Arabic-first bilingual mode.
summary.ar: نظام تشغيل بالذكاء الاصطناعي للعقارات: منصة B2B متعددة الوكلاء لتشغيل العمليات وإدارة علاقات العملاء والتسويق العقاري باللغة العربية أولًا.

description.en: Founder & Lead Architect of a ~400K-LOC, 146-project Nx monorepo: NestJS 11 backend with four Angular 21 SSR frontends, a 75-model PostgreSQL schema with ZenStack policy-based access control, Redis/Bull queues, MinIO storage and Socket.IO real-time inbox.

highlights.en: Hierarchical multi-agent AI platform on LangGraph + deepagents: an orchestrator delegates to 12 specialised subagents across 23 tool suites.
Graph long-term memory (Neo4j/Memgraph), RAG with embeddings and RRF reranking, human-in-the-loop interrupts and SSE streaming.
Meta/Instagram Graph API, WhatsApp Business and Meta Ads integrations with resilient clients (circuit breaker, retry/backoff, rate limiting).
AI visual website builder and Arabic-first bilingual RTL/LTR experience.

summary.en: Provider-agnostic AI coding orchestration platform: one AI-orchestration core shipping as a VS Code extension, Electron desktop app and headless CLI.
summary.ar: منصة توجيه برمجة بالذكاء الاصطناعي مستقلة عن المزود: نواة واحدة تُشحن كإضافة VS Code وتطبيق Electron لسطح المكتب وأداة سطر أوامر (CLI).

description.en: Creator & Lead Architect of a 68-project Nx monorepo built with hexagonal ports-and-adapters design, unifying Claude, GitHub Copilot, OpenAI Codex, Cursor and local Ollama models.

highlights.en: Provider-agnostic harness with 5 provider families and 6 CLI adapters plus multi-strategy authentication.
Built-in MCP server (~40 tools, 14 namespaces): AST parsing, LSP navigation, dependency graphs, symbol indexing, sqlite-vec vector memory and CDP browser automation.
Parallel multi-agent orchestration (up to 9 concurrent agents), trajectory-based skill synthesis and SQLite cron scheduler.
Telegram/Discord/Slack bridges and a NestJS + Prisma licensing backend (Paddle, WorkOS).

summary.en: Open-source MCP-compliant guidance system that steers AI agents (Cursor, Claude) to follow enforced architectural patterns.
summary.ar: نظام إرشاد مفتوح المصدر متوافق مع MCP، يوجّه وكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي (Cursor وClaude) لاتباع أنماط معمارية مُلزِمة.

description.en: Creator & Lead Architect of a NestJS + Prisma backend with a structured anti-hallucination workflow that verifies agent output against codebase facts.

highlights.en: MCP-compliant guidance layer for AI agents working in existing codebases.
Enforces architectural patterns and verifies generated output against project facts.
Anti-hallucination workflow built with NestJS and Prisma.
